original_release_units_excerpt:
The NIRSpec 1D spectra have this structure:

No.	Name  		Type  	 	          Format
  0  	PRIMARY   	     PrimaryHDU 		– 	 
  1  	EXTRACT1D	     BinTableHDU                  [D, D, D]

The fits binary table in the EXTRACT1D extension contains 3 columns:
Flux in units of W m-3
Flux uncertainty in units of W m-3
Wavelength in units of m

The NIRSpec 2D spectra have this structure:

No.	Name  		Type  	 	          Format
  0  	PRIMARY   	      PrimaryHDU 		– 	 
  1  	FLUX       	      ImageHDU    		float64     Flux in units of W m-3
  2  	FLUX_ERR          ImageHDU    		float64     Flux uncertainty in units of W m-3
  3  	WAVELENGTH    ImageHDU   		float64     Wavelength in units of m
  4  	RA                        ImageHDU   		float64     Right Ascension along the slitlet
  5  	DEC                     ImageHDU   		float64     Declination along the slitlet

The JADES processed prism spectra are output on an irregular pixel grid due to the variable spectral resolution of the prism. Therefore one must use the WAVELENGTH array rather than header wcs parameters.
The ASDF extensions in the NIRSpec files are empty and are included for compatibility with software that understands the MAST JWST product format.
